plain_description.what: A sweep of every statement in the project record that calls a data split or reserved question set 'clean'. Each is classified by whether it was only checked by question id or also by question text.
plain_description.why: Pools were found to be separated by id but not always by content (duplicate question texts can sit on both sides), so 'clean' claims may be overstated.
plain_description.information: It shows which claims need a correction bracket and whether contamination reached any scoring. Result: done (no new calls). 80 unbracketed id-only 'clean' claims were found across 575 rows. A small number of near-twin questions sat in the tree's labelling and rubric material. The link problem never reached a scorer, and the remaining corrections are queued as a mechanical follow-up. It does not adjudicate all 80 rows (18 were sampled) and does not cover near-duplicates.
